title: 第24章 和他爷爷一样
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
上等水灵根！

    这...郁凡想到现在已经不再是以前的异世界了，不由得舒了一口气。

    还好，这里是蓝星。

    要知道在异界，上等资质水灵根可是不少人会争抢的，毕竟这可是一个极好的炉鼎。

    郁凡无论如何也不会让自己的孙女变成别人的炉鼎。

    他笑了笑，“水灵根，资质上等。”

    听到自己也有灵根还是上等资质，郁颜不由得高兴的跳了起来，“耶！我也是有灵根的人！太好了，我可以修炼了。”

    郁凡笑看着自家孙女开心的笑颜，想着，不管是在地球还是在其他世界，他都会守护好这个笑颜。

    绝对不允许有人破坏她眼中的光彩。

    “归我了！归我了！”郁凌迫不及待的上前，终于轮到他了！

    他窜上前便将手放在法器上，一会儿后，那些原本暖白色的光芒渐渐消失了，三分钟后，法器呈现透明状。

    郁凌大惊，“爷爷，为什么会什么都没有？我是不是没有灵根？”

    他差点要哭了，他哥哥是金灵根，姐姐是水灵根，而自己却什么都没有？

    枉费自己期待了这么久...

    “哈哈哈，好！不愧是我郁凡的孙子！”郁凡高兴极了！

    他拍了拍郁凌的肩膀，“好小子！”

    郁凌欣喜的抬起头，“爷爷？”

    “我是有灵根的吗？”

    郁凡大笑着点头，“没想到啊，千万年难遇的天灵根，我们家居然出现了两个！”

    “天灵根？”郁凌疑惑的询问郁凡，“爷爷，我是天灵根吗？还有一个人是谁？”

    郁凡摸了摸郁凌的脑袋，“还有一个就是你爷爷我。”

    “我和爷爷一样的灵根？！”郁凌惊喜极了，他自从知道自家爷爷的厉害后，便极为崇拜爷爷。

    没想到，自己居然会和爷爷一样的灵根。

    “你之所以看不到颜色是因为天灵根是灵根极为纯净的一种，至于修炼方向你可以随意选择五行中的任何一项去修炼，修炼速度相比较其他灵根修炼速度要更快速。”

    “所以，这是一种非常好的灵根！”郁凌笑咧了嘴。
content_en:
The finest water spirit root!

This... Yu Fan couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief when he thought that it was no longer the different world before.

Fortunately, this is Blue Star.

You must know that in other worlds, many people will compete for the high-quality water spirit root. After all, this is an excellent furnace.

Yu Fan would never let his granddaughter become someone else's furnace.

He smiled and said, "Shui Ling Gen, excellent qualifications."

Hearing that she also had spiritual roots and had superior qualifications, Yu Yan couldn't help but jump up with joy, "Yeah! I also have spiritual roots! Great, I can practice now."

Yu Fanxiao looked at his granddaughter's happy smile and thought, whether on earth or in other worlds, he would protect this smile.

No one was allowed to ruin the sparkle in her eyes.

"It's mine! It's mine!" Yu Ling couldn't wait to step forward. It was finally his turn!

He rushed forward and put his hand on the magic weapon. After a while, the originally warm white light gradually disappeared. Three minutes later, the magic weapon became transparent.

Yu Ling was shocked, "Grandpa, why is there nothing? Do I have no spiritual roots?"

He almost cried. His brother had a golden spirit root, his sister had a water spirit root, but he had nothing?

I waited so long in vain...

"Hahaha, good! As expected of me, Yu Fan's grandson!" Yu Fan was extremely happy!

He patted Yu Ling's shoulder and said, "Good boy!"

Yu Ling raised his head happily, "Grandpa?"

"Do I have spiritual roots?"

Yu Fan laughed and nodded, "I didn't expect that there would be two Tianlinggens in our house that are rare to see in millions of years!"

"Tianlinggen?" Yu Ling asked Yu Fan doubtfully, "Grandpa, am I Tianlinggen? Who is the other person?"

Yu Fan touched Yu Ling's head, "The other one is your grandfather and me."

"My grandpa and I have the same spiritual roots?!" Yu Ling was extremely surprised. Ever since he knew how powerful his grandpa was, he had admired him very much.

Unexpectedly, I would have the same spiritual root as my grandfather.

"The reason why you can't see the color is because Tianling root is an extremely pure type of spiritual root. As for the direction of cultivation, you can choose any of the five elements to practice at will. The cultivation speed is faster than the cultivation speed of other spiritual roots."

"So, this is a very good spiritual root!" Yu Ling grinned.
